author: Astrokillah
text:
Guys, for those that understood this fully, please help me out here, I can't expect Master IF to keep repeating what has already been said, but my brain is just too stupid to understand simple English.

I am referring to his statement in the chart below: "This didn't break into CP, and if it had, the next TG was the BSZK below"

I must be missing some key RTM concept here. I enlarge the AREA 1 in chart below to facilitate discussion:

What I have learned about Compression is the following: - Compression consists of two parts: Pre-compression (PCP) and the Tip (or End) of the compression (TCP); - Both Pre-compression and the Tip of the Compression are area where price can bounce, including Ignored PCP and Ignored TCP; - If price engulfs PCP and breaks into the CPAZ, then it will likely travel all the way to the TCP.

So IF was saying that: If price broke into CP, the next target would be a BSZK, which was the KINK inside the bullish candle 1. Now, what if price did not break into the CP? What will be the next target be?

My confusion is that, regardless of whether price breaks into the CP or not, it can always retrace to the KINK to 'reload' before resuming the next attack. Am I wrong in my understanding? Please kindly correct.

The following charts are just to complete the picture.

Thank you all very much! AK

H@S - just high at supply (take a look at red rectangle) L@WRB - low at wide range bar (pole - a big candle) RS - hmm, maybe just resistance/support - not sure about this one:)
